comments.author: @GlobalLifeInsights
comments.text: When I first moved up to high altitude, the hardest adjustment wasn't even the thin air... it was trying to boil water at 190°F and realizing my food would NEVER cook without a pressure cooker!

comments.author: @RealLifeExplorerUS
comments.text: The visuals of the Potala Palace and palaces in the clouds were breathtaking. The resilience of Tibetan people living in such harsh, brutal geography is truly inspiring. Endless respect!
